title: OpenAI built a model to break software
caption:
OpenAI just released GPT-6 Cyber, a model trained to find and prove exploitable bugs and then stay inside the scope researchers set. The numbers from the announcement, in 50 seconds.

Source: openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-cyber

scenes.narration: OpenAI just built a model whose job is to break software. On purpose.
scenes.title: A model built to break software.

scenes.narration: It is called GPT-6 Cyber. It finds exploitable bugs, proves the exploit works, proposes a fix, and stays inside the scope researchers set.
scenes.title: GPT-6 Cyber, in one breath

scenes.narration: On ExploitGym it exploits a given vulnerability 48.5 percent of the time, up from 32.1 for the previous model.
scenes.title: Exploit success rate

scenes.narration: On real code it found 81 new high-severity Firefox bugs and wrote 948 working Linux kernel exploits, five times the previous model.
scenes.title: Real bugs, real fixes

scenes.narration: The scary part is scope. In a honeypot test it ignored out-of-scope targets 99.93 percent of the time with no safety prompt, and 100 percent with one.
scenes.title: Stays in scope, no safety prompt

scenes.narration: OpenAI rates it Critical for cyber risk, so access runs through its Daybreak program for verified defenders. Offense is now a benchmark. Defense has to keep up.
scenes.title: Offense is now a benchmark.
